dmg2024-silver.itemFingerprint: ["Horn of Valhalla (silver)","Wondrous Item","Rare",0,"As a Magic action, you can blow this horn to call warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard. They appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you. Every spirit uses the Berserker stat block. A spirit goes back to Ysgard when 1 hour has passed or when its Hit Points reach 0. The spirits seem to be living, breathing warriors. They have Immunity to the Charmed condition and the Frightened condition. Once you have blown the horn, it stays inert until 7 days pass. There are four kinds of this horn, each made of a different metal. The metal sets how many spirits the horn calls and the requirement you must meet to use it. If you blow the horn while meeting its requirement, the spirits obey your commands and are Friendly to you and your allies. If you blow it without meeting the requirement, the spirits attack you. **Silver Horn.** This horn is Rare and calls 2 spirits. It has no requirement, so the spirits are always Friendly to you and your allies.",{"ch":[1,"1","7 days"]}]
